roles.label: Business Operations Architect
roles.headline: Business Operations Architecture | Information Architecture | Operational Systems
roles.summary: Business Operations Architect focused on understanding how functions operate, connecting separately maintained information, reconciling business definitions and designing sustainable operational systems. Combines business discovery, information architecture, data governance and practical implementation to support coherent decisions while preserving functional ownership.

roles.label: Enterprise / Business Architect
roles.headline: Business Architecture | Enterprise Information Architecture | Transformation
roles.summary: Business-focused architect connecting operating models, information architecture, governance and technology enablement. Translates fragmented business domains into coherent structures, shared definitions and reusable foundations aligned with how the organisation needs to operate.

roles.label: Digital Transformation Leader
roles.headline: Digital Transformation | Business Systems | Process & Data Enablement
roles.summary: Transformation leader who redesigns the systems behind work, not simply digitises existing tasks. Combines process discovery, information architecture, workflow redesign and practical technology to reduce fragmentation, improve governance and build solutions people can adopt.

roles.label: Strategy & Transformation
roles.headline: Strategy & Transformation | Operating Model | Decision Intelligence
roles.summary: Strategic transformation practitioner who turns organisational ambiguity into aligned operating structures and decision-ready information. Works across functions to clarify priorities, expose dependencies and design governance and information systems that improve leadership visibility and execution coherence.
